description:
Keyword research, each with volume, difficulty, CPC, intent, competition (0 to 1), bids, alsoIntents, serpFeatures (what Google shows), topTen (its strength), Opportunity (0 to 100), fit (0 to 3), onTopic and saved. Off-topic rows are held back and counted (offTopicHidden). Up to 450 rows (limit, 100 by default; a list: all you give), in the workspace's market or any country, language and city. One keyword search per 150 keywords back: up to 150 = 1, 300 = 2, 450 = 3; a list 1 per 150 of its keywords; a city adds 1. The same search within 30 days is free. Save the good ones with update_keywords.
from:
- seed(query, limit?, months?, includeOffTopic?, country?, language?, city?): Ideas around a seed search.
- competitor(domain, limit?, months?, includeOffTopic?, country?, language?, city?): The searches a site ranks for (any domain, up to 450, the ones bringing it the most visits first), with its position, theirPage (its page that ranks) and theirTraffic (visits a month from it).
- gap(domain, limit?, months?, includeOffTopic?, country?, language?, city?): Searches a rival ranks for and the site doesn't, with theirPage and theirTraffic.
- list(keywords, months?, country?, language?, city?): The numbers for keywords you give (1 to 700), every one graded and scored, none held back.
name: research_keywords
title: Research keywords
